findings.problem: Section 14.2 starts foreground work without waiting for an old read, while 21.1 requires refresh not to overlap foreground work. Section 14.3 also requires a fresh read after action completion even if the obsolete read has not settled, conflicting with 14.1's no-concurrent-refresh rule.
findings.fix: Explicitly allow only an already-running obsolete observational read to overlap the action; keep its result invalidated. Bound and drain that read before starting the post-action refresh, and align the verification wording.

findings.problem: Connector-update guidance disables Pair in both keyboard and menu paths, but its code is optional and expires. No renewal or instruction-completion rule is specified, including when old valid tokens keep authorization true during connector replacement.
findings.evidence: src/pairing/manager.ts defaults to a five-minute code TTL; src/cli/index.ts permits pairing generation to fail while retaining connector-update instructions.
findings.fix: Allow the existing Pair operation contextually within connector recovery when the endpoint is ready, even with old valid tokens; allow missing/expired code renewal and define when the transient instruction is dismissed or completed. Test both cases.

otherCorrectionsConfirmed: Phase 2 is explicitly optional for SPEC-003 completion.
Keyboard and menu actions share one authoritative table.
Missing visual reference now has an explicit restoration requirement.
scope: Spec and implementation left unchanged; only this review evidence file was added.
